plain_english_revision: This amendment removes all references to the State Superintendent of Education from sections of SB170 related to COVID-19 vaccine mandates or policies. It also deletes several paragraphs (lines 4–12, 17–19 on page 18; lines 21–27/20:1–6 on page 19/20) and renumbers the remaining text to maintain continuity.
candidate_position_supported: Advances a policy effect that eliminates state-level oversight of vaccine-related provisions in public education and Medicaid/healthcare contexts, without specifying alternative accountability mechanisms.
evidence_quotes: delete lines 4 to 12, inclusive, and renumber the remaining subdivision accordingly
review_reason: The amendment’s substantive intent is unclear without seeing the deleted text. The removal of the Superintendent of Education may affect vaccine mandates, but procedural gaps remain.
